title: Season review says the published results are still unsaved
steps: Start a three-season or ten-season Showdown with Daniel and Nik.
Finish the season transfer guesses and reveal the signings.
Enter Daniel’s season result, review it and press Publish My Season Result.
Enter Nik’s season result, review it and press Publish My Season Result.
Read the instruction below Both Managers Published. The same instruction remains after the season score is accepted.
expected: The review should say both results have been published and are final, then explain the next season step using the button that is actually shown.
actual: Both results are published and can no longer be edited, but the visible review still says: “Nothing becomes permanent until Confirm & Save Season is pressed.” Confirm & Save Season is not shown.
root_cause: The review keeps the old save instruction created by ensureSeasonReviewUI. pssrRenderReview changes the heading, result message and buttons for the current publish steps but never replaces the introduction.

fix.change: Update .seasonReviewIntro along with each review step. Before publishing, ask the manager to check their own result; after publishing, say that result is final; after both publish, say both results are saved and use the current season button name.

This is a misleading instruction; no lost result or incorrect score was observed.
